update.title: MAJOR UPDATE: The Ultimate Training & Datalink Experience
features: LIVE Instructor Operating Station (IOS) with real-time zero-latency cockpit screen sharing and audio.
Instant Aircraft Repositioning by instructors to practice complex approaches and procedures on the fly.
Dynamic Failure Injection system allowing instructors to silently trigger unexpected emergencies mid-flight.
Fully Functional ACARS & CPDLC Datalink with seamless VATSIM and IVAO network integration.
TELEX Free-Text Messaging to ATC and live network traffic, plus one-tap Quick ATC Requests.
Authentic CPDLC Station to respond to urgent ATC instructions and file Oceanic Position Reports.

announcement.title: A Complete Game-Changer is Here!
announcement.body:
Get ready to take your flight simulation experience to an unprecedented level! We are bringing 100% authentic airline datalink operations and a revolutionary Instructor Operating Station directly to your fingertips. Share your live cockpit with an instructor, master complex IFR procedures, send TELEX messages, and respond to ATC via our true-to-life CPDLC interface.

IMPORTANT: To unlock these groundbreaking features and maintain a stable connection, you MUST download the latest Simulator Station Bridge and Broadcast files from the Documentation section. Update your bridge now and see you in the virtual skies!

promo_banner.title: Study-Level ACARS & CPDLC
promo_banner.body: Say goodbye to typing long messages in chat boxes. Send TELEX messages, request clearances, and respond to ATC instantly with our authentic datalink architecture.
